senses.zh_definition: Joanne：人名，通常用作女性名字；不是据现有材料可以确立的马来语普通词。

senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang, lazimnya nama perempuan; bahan yang diberikan tidak mengesahkannya sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu.

etymology.historical_story: Personal names travel with people across languages. An official Malaysian police profile uses Joanne as a name, illustrating how Malay prose accommodates names without turning them into ordinary Malay vocabulary. That attestation establishes a naming use only. The supplied lowercase token does not establish its bearer, pronunciation, Jawi spelling, or individual naming history.
